name: Portoferraio (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Portoferraio (a sailing ship on the sea on light blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Portoferraio, a comune in Tuscany; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Portoferraio arms — sailing ship on the sea, crowned, within branches
